note: SPEC-WEB.md section 7.2 cross-check fixture. Each case's input_units is what a user would drag onto the board; expected_vector/nearest_comp/distance/matched_comp are what features.py's vector + a nearest-centroid cosine match (section 7.3) produce for it. Boards were pre-filtered to exclude any where an emblem or other trait-granting item would make a pure unit-count trait derivation disagree with the real pipeline vector — see build_web_data.py's build_selftest_cases() docstring.
